description: This Java source file defines assertions for verifying MongoDB index configurations within the context of testing. It provides methods to assert the presence and correctness of MongoDB indices, particularly ignoring the default '_id' index when specified.

classes.name: MongoIndexAssertions
classes.description: Contains static methods to assert MongoDB index states in testing scenarios, supporting index comparison and ignoring default '_id' index.

methods.name: assertIndices
methods.description: Asserts that a MongoDB collection contains the expected indices, with an option to ignore the default '_id' index.

methods.name: assertIndices (private overload)
methods.description: Compares actual and expected index lists after sorting them, asserting their equality.

methods.name: removeDefaultIndex
methods.description: Filters out the default '_id' index from a collection of indices.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Blocks and waits for the completion of a CompletionStage, converting it to a synchronous call.
